supplementalReference.inspection: Native full photograph plus tower and base crops actually inspected. Clear red-painted open four-leg lattice with dense diagonal panels, central vertical lift framing, broad white-framed polygonal glass observation deck, stacked open platforms, two visible small corner cupolas and curved open crown/flag mast. Intrinsic red-brick base has repeated tall narrow white windows, pale half-round end windows below stepped dormer/gable fronts, slate roof/glazed upper strip, low entry arches and corner piers. Adjacent large cream Art Deco clock/store facade and modern shops are separate unless native map explicitly proves an intrinsic connection. Beach/pier/promenade/tram/seasonal lights/artwork/people/branding excluded.
